lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, displaying an irregular grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a secondary lattice structure, most prominent in the region between the posterior gills and the pectoral fin insertion.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is present across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-reflectance pixels on the dorsal side to shadow-biased pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, low-luminance elongated objects (likely commensal organisms) located near the ventral-lateral junction of the pectoral fin and posterior to the fourth gill slit.
